scripts.test:physics: python3 tools/prepare-physics-check.py && node tools/prepare-render-check.mjs && cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/physics-check/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:sky: python3 tools/prepare-physics-check.py && node tools/prepare-render-check.mjs && python3 tools/prepare-sky-check.py && cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/physics-check/Cargo.toml -- --sky && python3 tools/summarize-sky-check.py
scripts.test:post: npm run test:sky && node tools/prepare-post-check.mjs && python3 tools/prepare-post-pixels.py && cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/physics-check/Cargo.toml --bin post-check && python3 tools/summarize-post-check.py
scripts.test:spectrum: npm run test:post && python3 tools/prepare-spectrum-check.py && cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/physics-check/Cargo.toml -- --sky --spectrum && python3 tools/summarize-spectrum-check.py
scripts.test:prepass: npm run test:spectrum && cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/physics-check/Cargo.toml --bin prepass-check && python3 tools/summarize-prepass-check.py
